definitions.explanation: Formal reading of {昨日|きのう}, used in business correspondence, news reports, and other formal written or spoken contexts.

examples.japanese: {昨日|さくじつ}{到着|とうちゃく}しました。
{昨日|さくじつ}の{会議|かいぎ}の{議事録|ぎじろく}を{送|おく}ります。
examples.english: I will send you the minutes of yesterday's meeting.

examples.japanese: {昨日|さくじつ}、{総理|そうり}{大臣|だいじん}は{記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: Yesterday, the prime minister held a press conference.

notes:
The kanji {昨日} has two main readings: {きのう} (everyday) and {さくじつ} (formal). Use {さくじつ} in business correspondence, news reporting, and formal speech; use {きのう} in everyday conversation.

COMMON USES:
- {昨日|さくじつ}{付|づ}け: dated yesterday (for documents)
- {昨日|さくじつ}より: as of yesterday
- {昨日|さくじつ}{中|ちゅう}に: during the day yesterday

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {昨日|きのう}: yesterday — everyday spoken form
- {昨日|さくじつ}: yesterday — formal/business written form
- {一昨日|おととい}: the day before yesterday
